Three arrested in Ayodhya for consuming meat and alcohol on a river boat

Three individuals were arrested in Ayodhya after a video circulated online showing them consuming meat and alcohol on a boat in the Saryu River. The arrests occurred following the viral spread of the video, which sparked a row. The incident took place in a city considered religiously significant.
